book.name: Yoan
book.title: Varu poia to Yoan imbooda Jon—John

content: Yesu, ye vaen tau
Yesu isaav muul ighaze: “You taug to vaen tau.
Ve Tamaŋ, ye ŋginiiŋ to uum vaen. Mbo 80:8+; Is 5:1+

Yes to tineep tuŋia inim tiou, nene tinimale ai vaen boga. Boga tisob to anoŋadi tivot pooi maau, nene Tamaŋ ipook di tizi. Ve boga tisob to anoŋadi tivot pooi, nene ye irab motmotin matadi ve ighagharaat di, leso tiŋgalaaŋ ve anoŋadi katindi tivot. Ro 11:17+
Yam tonene, saveeŋ to nasavia payam, tauto igharaat gham ve aŋgalaaŋ wa. Yo 13:10, 17:17; Ep 5:26

Yam irau aneep tuŋia inim tiou, ve you naneep tuŋia ilat tiam. Agham ŋgar pa vaen boga. Ighaze ineep saguan pa vaen luvuŋa, pale boga tonowen ighur anoŋa? Maau. Ai boga irau ineep tuŋia ila ai luvuŋa, ghoro anoŋa. Ve yam tovene paam. Ighaze aneep tuŋia inim tiou maau, nene irau ghurla tiam ighur anoŋa poia eta maau. Kol 1:22+, 2:7

“You taug to ai vaen, ve yam animale vaen boga. Tamtoghon to ighaze ineep tuŋia inim tiou, ve you naneep tuŋia ila toni, nene pale ghurla toni ighur anoŋa popoia katindi. Ve ighaze aneep saguan payou, nene irau agham mbeb poia eta ivot maau. Ga 5:22+; Pil 2:13; Kol 1:10

Tamtoghon to ighaze ineep tuŋia inim tiou maau, nene ye inim ai booga gorgori to timbuti ve tipiyaava ila. Ai boga tovene, pale muri tindou di, ve tipiyaav di tisob tizala yab ighan di. Mt 3:10+, 7:19

Ighaze aneep tuŋia inim tiou, ve saveeŋ tiou ineep tuŋia ila lolomim ve ataghoni, yam irau aghason Tamaŋ Maaron pa sa mbeb to lolomim pani, ve ye pale igham mbeb tonenen ivot payam. Yo 14:13; 1Yo 5:14+
Ighaze ghurla tiam ighur anoŋa popoia katindi, nene pale apaghazoŋan Tamaŋ Maaron iza tiina toman tapiri ve poia toni, ve apatooŋ taumim paam aghaze yam taghoniiŋa tiou. Mt 5:16; Lu 6:43
You lolog ineep tiam kat inimale Tamaŋ lolo ineep tiou. Matamim kisin ŋgar tiou tonene, ve aneep ilooŋ ila irau sawa isob.

Ighaze matamim kisin tutuuŋ tiou tisob ve ataghon di, nene pale awatag kat aghaze you lolog payam kat, ve aneep ilooŋ ila ŋgar tiou tonene irau sawa isob. Inimale you. Matag kisin Tamaŋ tutuuŋ toni to naol ne, ve nataghon di. Tauto nawatag naghaze ye lolo ineep tiou kat, ve naneep ilooŋ ila ŋgar toni tonenen irau sawa isob. 1Yo 5:3
“You nasavia saveeŋ tonene payam, leso lolomim poia le poia kat inimale you.
Tutuuŋ to nasavia payam, nene vene: Lolomim pa taumim ve agham poian taumim, inimale you lolog payam ve nagham poian gham. Yo 13:34+; 1Yo 4:7+
Ighaze tamtoghon eta imbaad pataŋani pa ndita, ve ipul tau imaat padi, nene ipatooŋa ighaze ye lolo ineep todi kat. Ŋgar tovene ilib pa ataam tisob to lolood pa nditaad. Ro 5:7+; Ep 5:2; 1Yo 3:16
Ighaze ataghon tutuuŋ to naghuri payam, yam pale apatooŋ taumim aghaze you nditag kat to yam. Mt 12:50; Yo 14:23

Mbesooŋa eta iwatag katin uraat to tiina toni ighamghami ne maau. Eemoghon yam, ghoro awatagi. Pasa, saveeŋ isob to nalooŋa ila to Tamaŋ, tauto navotia payam ve alooŋa wa. Tovenen you irau nawaat gham mbesooŋa muul maau. Pale nawaat gham naghaze nditag kat. Mbnp 18:17; Mbaŋ 20:27; Yems 2:23

Yam taumim lolomim ve anim ataghon ghou maau. You taug to nasia gham anim leg, ve naghur gham pa ala ve agham uraat. Uraat to aghami, nene pale ighur anoŋa, ve anoŋa tonenen ineep itaghoni taghoni gha ila. Ighaze yam agham tovene, ve aghason Tamaŋ pa mbeb eta ila you izag, ye pale ilooŋ gham ve igham payam. Mt 28:19; Yo 14:13; Ep 1:4
Tovenen you naghur tutuuŋ payam tovene: Lolomim pa taumim ve agham poian taumim.” Yo 13:34
Yes to titaghon taan ŋgara, pale tighur koi pa Yesu tamtoghon toni

Yesu isaav padi muul tovene: “Ighaze yes to titaghon taan ŋgara tighur koi payam, matamim iŋgal: Ŋgar todi tonowen, paghu maau. Yes tighur koi payou muuŋ, tauto tighur koi payam paam. Mt 10:22; 1Yo 3:13

Ndiran to titaghon ŋgar to taan, inimale yam ataghon di pa ŋgar todi ve yamŋa raratemim, tone lolodi payam. Eemoghon maau. Pasa, you napas gham avot ila lolodi ve anim leg, ve apul ŋgar to taan wa. Tauto yes tighurghur koi payam. Lu 6:22; Yo 17:14; 1Yo 4:5

Matamim iŋgal saveeŋ to you nasavia payam: Mbesooŋa eta irau ilib pa tiina toni ne maau. Tovenen yes to tighur pataŋani payou, nene pale tighur pataŋani payam paam. Ve yes to matadi kisin saveeŋ tiou ve titaghoni, nene pale matadi kisin saveeŋ tiam paam ve titaghoni. Mt 10:24+; 2Tim 3:12; 1Yo 4:6
Tamaŋ to imbaaŋ ghou nanim, tamtoghon to titaghon ŋgar to taan, tiwatagi rita maau. Tauto yes pale tigham ŋgar tovene payam. Pasa, yam anim leg ve ataghon ghou. Mt 5:10+; Yo 16:2+

Inimale you nanim ve navotia saveeŋ padi maau, tone ledi sosor ila Maaron mata maau. Eemoghon you nanim ve navotia saveeŋ toni padi wa. Tauto, aazne, yes irau tipoon taudi pa sosor todi muul maau. Sosor todi ineep ghazooŋa wa. Lu 12:47; Yo 9:41; Ro 1:20; Yems 4:17
Tamtoghon to ighaze ighur koi payou, nene ighur koi pa Tamaŋ paam.

Uraat tintina to nagham di ila matadi, nene ŋgeu eta igham uraat tovene pa eta sone. Inimale nagham uraat tonene maau, tone ledi sosor ila Maaron mata maau. Eemoghon you nagham uraat tonowen ve tighita wa. Ve tighurghur koi pa yeru Tamaŋ sone. Tauto ledi sosor ila Maaron mata.
Ŋgar to tigham payou, nene itaghon saveeŋ to muuŋ timbooda ila tutuuŋ todi. Ighaze:

Yesu iseeŋ saveeŋ toni muul ighaze: “Palotiiŋa to pale inim, ye ineep to Tamaŋ. Ve you pale nambaaŋa izilat tiam. Ye Maaron tau Avuvu to ivot ila toni ve izi inim. Ye isasavia saveeŋ onoon moghon. Ve ye pale ipariaaŋ saveeŋ tiou, leso tamtoghon tighur inim tiou. Lu 24:49; Yo 16:14; Mbaŋ 2:33
Ve yam paam pale apariaaŋ saveeŋ tiou. Pasa, sawa to napamundigin uraat tiou le imuul aazne, yam anepneep toman ghou. Lu 24:48; Mbaŋ 1:8; 1Yo 1:1+

footnotes.text: Muuŋ, Maaron igham yes Israela nditimbudi tila tivot taan to yes Kanaana, ve igham taan tonowen padi, leso tineep pani, ve tigham ŋgar popoia tivotvot, inimale ai vaen ighurghur anoŋa popoia. Eemoghon sawa naol, yes Israela titaghon ŋgar poia maau. Ve Yesu, ye igham ŋgar poia ivot itaghon Maaron ŋgar toni. Tauto iwaat tau ighaze ye vaen tau.
